seo.title: ERPG — Pixel Action RPG MMO
seo.description: ERPG is a pixel-art action RPG MMO — real-time combat, a persistent open world, deep character builds, and guild PvP. Free to play, cross-platform.

hero.title: Forge your legend in ERPG, the pixel-art action RPG MMO
hero.subtitle: Real-time combat, a living open world, and thousands of players fighting, trading, and raiding alongside you — free to play on PC and mobile.

features.title: A full MMO packed into a pixel-art world
features.subtitle: Everything you'd expect from an action RPG MMO — fast combat, real stakes, and a world worth exploring.

combat.title: Real-time action combat
combat.description: Dodge, combo, and unleash skill chains in fast, skill-based battles — no auto-attack, every hit is yours to land.

world.title: A persistent open world
world.description: Explore a seamless MMO world shared with thousands of adventurers, from starter fields to endgame dungeons.

pixelArt.title: Hand-crafted pixel art
pixelArt.description: Every character, monster, and biome is hand-drawn pixel art, animated frame by frame for a retro feel with modern polish.

classes.title: Deep classes & builds
classes.description: Pick a class and specialize your skill tree, gear, and playstyle — respec anytime as new strategies emerge.

guilds.title: Guilds, raids & PvP
guilds.description: Form a guild, siege territory, and battle other players in arenas and open-world PvP zones.

crossplay.title: Cross-platform play
crossplay.description: One account, one world — play on PC or mobile and pick up right where you left off.

testimonials.title: Loved by an adventuring community of thousands

items.quote: The combat feels tighter than most action RPGs I've played on PC, and it's running on my phone.
items.name: Minh Tran

items.quote: I've sunk 200 hours in and I'm still finding new dungeons and builds to try.
items.name: Jess Okafor

items.quote: The pixel art world is gorgeous — every zone has its own mood and soundtrack.
items.name: Daniel Kim

download.title: Free to play, on every platform
download.subtitle: ERPG is free forever, with cross-platform progression — pick your platform and jump in.
download.note: No purchase required to play. In-game purchases are optional and cosmetic only.

items.question: Is ERPG free to play?
items.answer: Yes — ERPG is free to play forever. Founder Packs are optional and only offer cosmetics and convenience, never power you can't earn in-game.

items.question: What platforms can I play on?
items.answer: ERPG runs on PC (Windows/macOS) and mobile (iOS/Android) with full cross-platform play and progression on a single account.

items.question: Does ERPG have PvP?
items.answer: Yes — arena duels, guild sieges, and open-world PvP zones with dedicated rewards and rankings.

items.question: How often is new content added?
items.answer: We ship balance patches monthly and a major content update — new zones, dungeons, or classes — every season.

cta.title: Your adventure in ERPG starts now
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of players already exploring the world — free to play, no commitment.

contact.title: Join the community
contact.subtitle: Questions, bug reports, or feedback — reach out and the team (or a fellow adventurer) will get back to you.
contact.name: Name

footer.tagline: A pixel-art action RPG MMO. Free to play.

privacy.seoDescription: How ERPG collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you play the game or visit this website.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how ERPG ("we", "us", or "the game") collects, uses, and protects your information when you visit this website or play ERPG.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We may collect account information (username, email address), gameplay data (progress, in-game purchases, device and platform), and website usage data (pages visited, browser type) collected through standard analytics and cookies.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use collected information to operate and improve ERPG, process purchases, provide customer support, communicate service updates, and maintain fair play and security across the game.

sections.heading: Sharing of information
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share limited data with service providers who help us operate the game (hosting, payment processing, analytics), and only as required by law.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website uses cookies to remember your preferences (such as language and theme) and to understand how visitors use the site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work correctly.

sections.heading: Data retention & security
sections.body: We retain account and gameplay data for as long as your account is active, and take reasonable technical measures to protect it from unauthorized access.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us through the community channel on this website.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out via the contact section on our homepage.

terms.seoDescription: The terms and conditions governing your use of ERPG and this website.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of ERPG (the "game") and this website. By creating an account or playing ERPG, you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: You must be at least 13 years old, or the minimum age of digital consent in your country, to create an account and play ERPG. If you are under the age of majority, you must have permission from a parent or guardian.

sections.heading: Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to cheat, exploit bugs, use unauthorized third-party software, harass other players, or attempt to disrupt the game's servers or economy. Violations may result in suspension or termination of your account.

sections.heading: Virtual items & purchases
sections.body: Premium currency, Founder Packs, and other in-game items are licensed to you for use within ERPG and hold no real-world monetary value. Purchases are generally non-refundable except where required by law.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: ERPG, including its name, logo, artwork, and code, is owned by us or our licensors. You may not copy, modify, or redistribute any part of the game or this website without permission.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate your account for violation of these Terms or applicable law, at our discretion, with or without notice.

sections.body: ERPG is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the game.

sections.heading: Changes to these Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of ERPG after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: Questions about these Terms can be sent via the contact section on our homepage.
